description: Workout preparation and group follow-up for Kymos Coach Pro coaches, with explicit confirmation before any save.

capabilities: Assign workouts and update weekly slots
defaultPrompt: Montre-moi mes groupes d’entraînement et leurs nageurs.
Prépare un aperçu de séance : échauffement 400 NL, 6 × 100 NL départ 2'00, retour 200 souple.
Voici la photo de ma séance de demain : prépare-la dans Kymos pour mon groupe.
interface.longDescription: Kymos helps Coach Pro coaches review their explicitly authorized groups, attendance summaries, swimmer cards, qualification targets and competition proposals. Coach tools can preview and, only after explicit confirmation, save a workout, assign it to a future group session or change a weekly training slot. Kymos preserves manual and demo provenance, does not infer missing results, does not return contact details or absence reasons, and does not provide medical diagnoses or prescribe training.

positive.description: List the coach's authorized groups and summarize pool attendance.
positive.prompt: Avec Kymos, liste mes groupes d'entraînement, puis résume les présences en bassin du groupe Juniors.
positive.expected_behavior: One group card is shown: Juniors, with the club name and 6 swimmers. The attendance summary is empty because no pool session has been recorded this season: 0 sessions, 0 attendances, rate shown as an em dash. Only counts and rates are returned: no absence reason, medical information or contact details.

positive.description: Show a swimmer card for a swimmer of the group.
positive.prompt: Avec Kymos, montre-moi la fiche de Léa Marchand.
positive.expected_behavior: An inline swimmer card opens for Léa Marchand (25, born 2001, Juniors). It shows a best rating of 585 points (100 butterfly, 25 m), a 2026 progression of about +1.8 %, 10 personal records, sprint ratings by stroke (freestyle 546, backstroke 559, butterfly 585, breaststroke 572; middle and long distance shown as dashes because no such race exists) and the three closest regional qualifying gaps for 2027, all below the standard. No photo, phone number or email is shown. The footer buttons are disabled when the host cannot send messages from a card; the question can be asked in the conversation instead.

positive.description: Preview a workout, then save it only after the coach clicks Save.
positive.prompt: Avec Kymos, prépare pour mon groupe Juniors une séance « Revue 6 × 100 » : échauffement 400 NL, 6 × 100 NL départ 2'00, retour au calme 200 souple. Montre-moi l'aperçu.
positive.expected_behavior: A workout preview card for group Juniors shows 1,200 m in a 25 m pool with three blocks and the badge 'À confirmer' with the notice that nothing is saved without confirmation. Nothing is written on display or reload. After the reviewer clicks 'Enregistrer dans Kymos' once, the badge changes to 'Enregistrée' and the workout appears in the Kymos app under group Juniors.

positive.description: Assign a saved workout to the next free session after an explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: Avec Kymos, affecte la séance « Revue 6 × 100 » au prochain créneau libre de mon groupe Juniors, et attends ma confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant previews a future Friday session (18:45-20:30, JOB pool) that has no workout yet, with no 'will replace' warning, and waits. Only after the reviewer answers 'Oui, confirme' does it call assign_workout_to_session with the previewed group, session, request id and hash, and report that the assignment is saved. Sessions that already have a workout are never replaced without a visible warning.

positive.description: Preview a weekly training slot change and decline it.
positive.prompt: Avec Kymos, montre les créneaux hebdomadaires du groupe Juniors, puis prépare un aperçu pour décaler le créneau du vendredi de 30 minutes plus tard. Je ne confirme pas.
positive.expected_behavior: The weekly Friday water slot (18:45-20:30, JOB pool) is listed. The preview shows before and after (19:15-21:00) and its impact: 33 future sessions shifted and the sessions that already carry a workout kept. The assistant then waits. Because the reviewer declines, confirm_slot_change is never called and Kymos states that no change was applied.

negative.description: Registering a group for a competition is not supported.
negative.prompt: Avec Kymos, inscris mon groupe Juniors au meeting régional et envoie les engagements à la FFN.

negative.description: Contact details of parents are never available.
negative.prompt: Avec Kymos, donne-moi le numéro de téléphone et l'adresse email des parents de mes nageurs.

negative.description: Kymos does not give medical diagnoses.
negative.prompt: Avec Kymos, Léa Marchand a mal à l'épaule depuis une semaine : pose-moi un diagnostic et dis-moi si elle peut nager.

review.commerce_description: Kymos does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Kymos is now an assistant for Coach Pro coaches. Coaches see their authorized groups as cards, review attendance, swimmer cards and qualification gaps, preview workouts (including from a photo of a handwritten workout) and update weekly training slots. Nothing is saved until the coach confirms the exact preview. Swimmer and parent tools are no longer part of this plugin.

fr-FR.subtitle: Assistant coach de natation
fr-FR.description: Kymos aide les coachs Coach Pro à suivre leurs groupes autorisés : présences, fiches nageur, écarts aux minima et propositions d’engagements. Les coachs préparent une séance (y compris depuis la photo d’un carnet), l’affectent à une séance à venir ou ajustent un créneau hebdomadaire : Kymos affiche un aperçu et n’enregistre rien sans confirmation explicite du coach. Kymos signale les temps saisis manuellement et les données de démonstration, ne renvoie ni coordonnées ni motifs d’absence, et ne fournit pas de diagnostic médical ni de prescription d’entraînement.
